categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: electronic data forensics, public safety big data, digital government and enterprise digitalization, and new cyberspace security. These segments cover six major product categories with over 130 product series, serving government agencies, judicial bodies, administrative enforcement departments, and large enterprises. The company aims to be a global leader in electronic data forensics and public safety big data, while expanding strategic new businesses in digital government and cyberspace security.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing, and zero-trust security frameworks. It has developed proprietary platforms such as the 'QKOS' big data operating system and the 'Tianqing' public safety large model, integrating AI-driven data analysis, intelligent forensics, and security operations. Production focuses on R&D and high-value manufacturing, with assembly handled by a controlled subsidiary, adhering to ISO9001 and CMMI5 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include public security, judicial, administrative enforcement agencies, government departments, and large enterprises across sectors such as finance, education, and digital economy. The company also serves emerging markets in digital government, enterprise digital transformation, and network security. Its products and services support national digital governance, law enforcement, social governance, and enterprise digitalization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide across all provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions in China, with significant presence in East, South, Northeast, North, Southwest, and Central China. It also extends its market reach to Belt and Road countries, Hong Kong, and Macau, supporting international law enforcement and public safety projects.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company primarily operates in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital technology supply chain, focusing on R&D, product development, system integration, and service delivery. It manufactures electronic data forensics equipment and develops software platforms, while outsourcing assembly and some manufacturing to subsidiaries. It acts as a solution provider and technology enabler for government and enterprise customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating core businesses in electronic data forensics and public safety big data, while aggressively expanding digital government, enterprise digitalization, and cyberspace security. The company emphasizes AI and large model integration ('ALL IN AI' strategy), indigenous innovation, and development of autonomous, secure big data operating systems. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on AI-enabled forensics, data governance, network security, and intelligent public safety applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electronic data forensics equipment, big data platforms, and cybersecurity solutions. Additional income comes from system integration projects, technical services, software licensing, and cloud-based SaaS offerings. The company also earns from government contracts, training services, and long-term digital transformation projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a domestic leader in electronic data forensics and public safety big data, recognized as a national team in cyberspace security and social governance. It holds a leading market share with comprehensive product ecosystems and strong government relationships. Competitors include other domestic and international cybersecurity and big data firms, but the company differentiates through its integrated AI capabilities, extensive product portfolio, and strategic backing by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.77 billion, a 10.82% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 415 million, reflecting a decline due to delayed orders and increased sales expenses. Total assets stood at RMB 5.28 billion with equity of RMB 3.51 billion. Despite short-term setbacks, the company continues to invest in R&D and strategic expansion, aiming for high-quality growth and market leadership.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive, end-to-end electronic data forensics solutions with full evidence chain capabilities, AI-powered intelligent analysis, and secure data governance. Its proprietary big data operating system and public safety large model provide differentiated intelligent services for law enforcement and government digitalization. The integration of AI, big data, and zero-trust security frameworks offers customers advanced, reliable, and scalable solutions that enhance operational efficiency, compliance, and security in digital transformation and public safety.
